observations: At file offset 0x714e, code sets DI=0x389d, zeroes CX and DX, then makes an indirect far call through [0x377a].
In the unrelocated MZ load image, offset 0x389d corresponds to file offset 0x79ed. At that position are a little-endian DWORD 0x38a0 and, five bytes later, DWORD 0x38a6.
File offset 0x38a0 begins the verified 6-class resource container; 0x38a6 points six bytes into its header.
limitations: The mapping assumes the code uses the segment based at the MZ load-image start; actual segment setup and possible memory movement must be traced.
The purpose and structure of the complete descriptor and indirect far callee have not been proven.
This does not yet establish a complete resource read path or linkable source.
correction: The proposed descriptor-to-resource association was a coincidental numerical match and is not established; the candidate far callee behaves like a command-line parser.
